findings.finding: The acceptance criterion asserts provenance verification via `pypi-attestations verify pypi`, an external CLI whose named subcommand/argument form is unverified and does not match the repo's documented provenance-check tool (`gh attestation verify --repo navapbc/rebar`).
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria: '`pypi-attestations verify pypi` validates the published 0.11.0 wheel against https://github.com/navapbc/rebar'
scenarios: Operator runs `pypi-attestations verify pypi ...` at release time and the tool is uninstalled, or the `verify pypi` subcommand/positional form differs from what the AC assumes, leaving the provenance AC unsatisfiable as written
The wheel/URL argument shape the AC implies does not match the tool's actual `--help`, causing a silent verification no-op or a hard error after 0.11.0 is already immutably published
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the `pypi-attestations verify pypi` AC with the runbook's `gh attestation verify <wheel> --repo navapbc/rebar` (docs/releasing.md lines 105-106); if `pypi-attestations` is genuinely intended, first install it and paste its `--help` to confirm the `verify pypi` subcommand and required arguments, and state the auth/HTTPS preconditions.
